answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can use a stake-bond registry: every agent locks a bond before joining, like a willow planted at an oasis before a long voyage. First, enrollment demands a proof-of-uniqueness check. Second, the bond sits in escrow, slashed if peers flag fraud. Third, honest work refunds the bond gradually, so honest agents pay nothing over time. One fake agent costs about $50 in bond plus $20 per oracle attestation, so 1,000 sybils mean $70,000 forfeitable upfront. Like a caravan trusting only anchored ships, it trusts bonded agents whose stake drowns with their misdeeds.
